|lore=“With your wisdom, I’m sure that we can work out an arrangement which will be mutually beneficial and enable us to avoid any unpleasant confrontation.”
|game_text=Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, while You Can Either Profit By This... or Or Be Destroyed on table, may deploy one C-3PO, Chewie, Lando, Leia, or R2-D2 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, may place this Effect out of play to take a character from Lost Pile into hand. (Immune to Alter.)
|printings={{Card versions/Seeking An Audience}}
